parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json||{};const rows=r.rows||r.input?.rows||[];const cfg=r.config||r.input?.config||{};if(!Array.isArray(rows)) return [{json:{success:false,component_id:'C5-T',component_version:'v1',error:{code:'ROWS_NOT_ARRAY',message:'rows must be an array.'},next_action:'provide_rows'}}];const cols=cfg.columns||Array.from(new Set(rows.flatMap(x=>Object.keys(x||{}))));const esc=v=>{const s=String(v??'');return /[",\n]/.test(s)?`"${s.replace(/"/g,'""')}"`:s;};const csv=[cols.join(','),...rows.map(x=>cols.map(c=>esc(x?.[c])).join(','))].join('\n');return [{json:{success:true,component_id:'C5-T',component_version:'v1',export:{csv,json:rows,columns:cols,row_count:rows.length,filename_base:cfg.filename_base||'report'},next_action:'write_or_deliver_export',error:null}}];
